subject: lesen_englisch
title: A Cat Called Pepper
passage:
Sam has a black cat. Her name is Pepper. Pepper is three years old. She has green eyes and a white spot on her nose.
Every morning, Pepper sits by the kitchen door. She waits for her breakfast. Sam gives her fish and fresh water. Then Pepper goes into the garden.
One day, Pepper did not come home for dinner. Sam was very worried. He looked in the garden, under the car and in the garage. He called her name again and again. But there was no cat.
Then Sam heard a small sound. "Meow!" It came from the old tree next to the house. Pepper was high up in the tree, and she was scared. Sam's dad got a ladder and carefully brought her down.
That night, Pepper slept on Sam's bed. She was very happy to be home, and so was Sam.
stem: What colour are Pepper's eyes?
explanation: The text says: "She has green eyes and a white spot on her nose."

subject: lesen_englisch
title: The Lost Kite
passage:
It was a windy Saturday. Mia and her brother Ben went to the hill near their house with a big red kite.
Ben held the kite, and Mia ran with the string. The kite went up, up, up into the sky. "Look how high it is!" shouted Mia.
Suddenly, a very strong wind came. The string broke! The red kite flew away over the trees. Mia and Ben ran after it. They ran across a field and over a small bridge.
At last, they saw the kite. It was in a farmer's garden, next to some chickens. An old farmer came out and smiled. "Is this your kite?" he asked. "Yes!" said Ben. "Thank you!"
The farmer gave them the kite and two red apples. Mia and Ben walked home slowly. They were tired but happy. "Next time we need a stronger string," said Mia.
stem: What colour was the kite?
explanation: The text says they had "a big red kite".

subject: lesen_englisch
title: Penguins
passage:
Penguins are birds, but they cannot fly. Their wings are small and flat, like flippers. Penguins use them to swim. They are very good swimmers and can swim fast under the water.
Most penguins live in the south of the world. Some live in very cold places, like Antarctica. There is a lot of ice and snow there. Penguins have thick feathers and a layer of fat. This keeps them warm.
Penguins eat fish, squid and small sea animals called krill. They catch their food in the sea.
Emperor penguins are the biggest penguins. They can be over one metre tall. In winter, the father penguin keeps the egg warm on his feet for about two months. He does not eat in this time! The mother goes to the sea to find food. When she comes back, she helps to feed the baby.
stem: What do penguins use their wings for?
explanation: The text says: "Penguins use them to swim."

subject: lesen_englisch
title: Lily's First Day
passage:
Lily and her family moved to a new town in the summer. On Monday, she started at a new school. She did not know anyone, and she felt nervous.
Her new teacher, Mr Brown, was friendly. "Welcome, Lily!" he said. "You can sit next to Emma." Emma had long brown hair and a big smile. She showed Lily where to put her bag and coat.
In the first lesson, the class painted pictures. Lily painted her old house. Emma painted her dog. At break time, Emma asked, "Do you want to play with us?" Lily said yes. They played football with three other girls.
After school, Lily's mum asked, "How was your day?" Lily smiled. "It was great! I have a new friend. Her name is Emma, and she has a dog called Max."
Lily was not nervous anymore. She was excited about Tuesday.
stem: Who is Lily's new teacher?
explanation: The text says: "Her new teacher, Mr Brown, was friendly."

subject: lesen_englisch
title: The Water Cycle
passage:
Water is always moving. It goes round and round on our planet. We call this the water cycle.
First, the sun warms the water in seas, lakes and rivers. Some of the water turns into a gas called water vapour. It goes up into the air. We cannot see it.
High in the sky, the air is cold. The water vapour gets cold and turns into very small drops of water. Many small drops come together and make clouds.
When the drops get bigger and heavier, they fall down. This is rain. When it is very cold, they fall as snow.
The rain goes into rivers, lakes and the ground. Rivers take the water back to the sea. Then the sun warms the water again, and the cycle starts again.
The water you drink today was maybe once in a dinosaur's lake!
stem: What makes clouds?
explanation: The text says: "Many small drops come together and make clouds."

subject: lesen_englisch
title: The Picnic
passage:
On Sunday, the Green family went on a picnic. Mum made sandwiches. Dad packed apples, bananas and a big bottle of orange juice. Tom, who is nine, took a ball and a blanket.
They walked to the park by the lake. It was sunny and warm. They put the blanket under a big tree. Tom and Dad played football. Mum read a book.
At one o'clock, they were hungry. But when Mum opened the bag, there were no sandwiches! "Oh no! They are still on the kitchen table," she said.
Tom had an idea. "There is a café near the lake. Let's buy some food there." Dad liked the idea. They bought three big pizzas and ate them on the blanket.
Then a duck came and looked at them. Tom laughed and said, "I think the duck wants pizza too!" It was a funny day.
stem: What did Tom take to the picnic?
explanation: The text says: "Tom, who is nine, took a ball and a blanket."

subject: lesen_englisch
title: The Great Wall of China
passage:
The Great Wall of China is one of the most famous buildings in the world. It is in the north of China. It is very, very long – more than 20,000 kilometres with all its parts!
People started to build walls in China more than 2,000 years ago. Later, many emperors made the walls longer and stronger. The wall we often see in photos is about 500 years old. It is made of stone and bricks.
Why did they build it? The emperors wanted to keep enemies out. Soldiers lived in towers on the wall. When they saw enemies, they made fire and smoke. Other soldiers saw the smoke and came to help.
Building the wall was very hard work. Many thousands of people worked on it.
Today, millions of tourists visit the Great Wall every year. They walk on it and take photos of the beautiful mountains.
stem: What is the wall in the photos made of?
explanation: The text says: "It is made of stone and bricks."

subject: lesen_englisch
title: The Treasure Map
passage:
Leo and his best friend Nora found an old map in Leo's grandpa's shed. On the map was a big X next to a drawing of a well.
"Maybe there is treasure!" said Nora. Leo's grandpa had an old well in his garden. The children took a small shovel and went to the well.
They looked at the map again. "Ten steps to the big rock," read Leo. They walked ten steps and found the rock. Under the rock, the ground was soft. They started to dig.
After a few minutes, they found a metal box. Inside was a toy car, a shiny coin and a letter. The letter said: "I hid this box when I was ten years old. – Jack."
They ran to Grandpa. He laughed. "Jack is my name! I made that map sixty years ago." Grandpa was very happy to see his old toy car again.
stem: Where did the children find the map?
explanation: The text says they "found an old map in Leo's grandpa's shed".

subject: lesen_englisch
title: Busy Squirrels
passage:
Squirrels are small animals with big, bushy tails. In Germany, many squirrels are red or brown. You can see them in parks, gardens and forests.
Squirrels live in trees. They build nests from small sticks, leaves and moss. A squirrel's nest is called a drey.
In autumn, squirrels are very busy. They collect nuts, seeds and acorns. They hide this food in many different places. They dig small holes in the ground and put the nuts in them. In winter, when there is not much food, they come back and look for the nuts.
But squirrels do not find all their nuts. They forget some of them. In spring, some of these nuts grow into new trees. So squirrels help to plant forests!
A squirrel's tail is very useful. It helps the squirrel to jump from tree to tree. In cold weather, the squirrel uses its tail like a blanket.
stem: What is a squirrel's nest called?
explanation: The text says: "A squirrel's nest is called a drey."

subject: lesen_englisch
title: The Snow Day
passage:
When Anna woke up on Tuesday, everything was white. It snowed all night! On the radio, a man said, "All schools are closed today because of the snow."
"Hooray!" shouted Anna. She put on her warm coat, her hat, her scarf and her boots. Then she ran outside with her little brother Finn.
First, they built a big snowman. It had a carrot nose and two black stones for eyes. Anna gave it her old red scarf. Next, they had a snowball fight with their neighbours. Finn was very good at it!
After two hours, their hands and feet were very cold. They went inside. Mum made hot chocolate for everyone.
In the afternoon, they went sledging on the hill behind the church. Anna went down the hill ten times.
In the evening, Anna was very tired. "Can it snow again tomorrow?" she asked.
stem: What did Anna give the snowman?
explanation: The text says: "Anna gave it her old red scarf."
